descriptions.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Community.

As Galactic Custodians, the [custodian.GetName] has called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

descriptions.zh:
星海参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海共同体开战了。

参议院的代表们呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击，他们对外公示道：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] as of today finds itself in a state of total war with the entire Community.

Representatives from the Senate have called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory, declaring that "the galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

label.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？

options.script: name = crisis.4100.a

descriptions.zh:
帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。

在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”
descriptions.en:
The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.

In a public announcement transmitted from [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] called upon all members of the Imperium to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy and the Imperium will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

label.zh: 我们能够阻止他们的蹂躏吗？

options.script: name = crisis.4100.a

titles.zh: 共同体指定我方为“星系危机”

descriptions.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在星海监管人的领导之下，他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
descriptions.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Under the leadership of the Galactic Custodian, their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

descriptions.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

他们的舰队集结在了一起，向我们的领域发动了进攻。席卷整个星系的战争终于拉开帷幕。
descriptions.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

descriptions.zh:
星海共同体内那些腐败的蠢材通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海共同体现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者星海共同体废除这项议案。
descriptions.en:
The corrupt fools in the Galactic Community have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Community.

This war will continue until either us or the Community have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

titles.zh: 帝国指定我方为“星系危机”

descriptions.zh:
由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海帝国的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海帝国的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

在[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的领导下，他们的舰队已经集结，并向我们的领域发动进攻。席卷整个星系的战争拉开了帷幕。
descriptions.en:
Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Imperium have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of Imperial unity, the members of the Imperium have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Under the leadership of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], their fleets are assembling to launch an attack on our territory. The battle for the galaxy has begun.

descriptions.zh:
[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]和帝国参议院里那群腐败的马屁精通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海帝国现在已经处于战争状态。

这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者他们废除这项议案。
descriptions.en:
The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and their corrupt lackeys in the Imperial Senate have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Imperium.

This war will continue until either us or the Imperium have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

descriptions.zh: 指定§H[former_crisis.GetName]§!为“星系危机”的议案如今已被星海参议院废止。作为结果，所有由星海共同体成员国针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]展开的军事行动都被立马叫停。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
descriptions.en: The resolution designating the §H[former_crisis.GetName]§! as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Galactic Senate. As a result, all ongoing military operations being conducted by Community members against the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are to cease at once. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

options.script: name = crisis.4110.a

descriptions.zh: 星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。
descriptions.en: The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

descriptions.zh:
星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。

如果我们还想继续打下去，没什么能够阻止我们对这些蠢蛋分别宣战，然后一个接一个地干翻他们……
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...

label.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
label.en: So they came to their senses.

descriptions.zh: 指定§H[former_crisis.GetName]§!为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。
descriptions.en: The resolution designating the §H[former_crisis.GetName]§! as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

options.script: name = crisis.4110.a

descriptions.zh: 星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。
descriptions.en: The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

label.zh: 理智终于占领了他们大脑的高地了。
label.en: So they came to their senses.

descriptions.zh:
对称为§H鸿景§!的这一现象的调查有了结论。

其根源正如我们的预期，是§H虚境§!。随着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想暴露于内在超凡能量中并受其影响，也许我们是时候要开始集中精力逼迫这个领域满足我们的需求了。
descriptions.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon known as §Hthe Great Prospect§! has concluded.

Its origins are, as expected, of §Hthe Shroud§!. With the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exposed to and influenced by the ethereal energies within, it is perhaps time we began a more focused effort to instead bend this realm to our needs.

descriptions.zh: 我们沿着这些迷思逆流而上，追溯着那些零碎意识的他者之梦，跟从着我们自己的意图——也就是[GetBredLoc]子个体。这种冲动来自物质界以外，发自§H虚境§!的深处。时候到了，就如同它能影响而我们一般——我们也开始能逼迫它屈从于我们的意志。
descriptions.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-[GetBredLoc] drones. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from within the §HShroud§!. The time has come, just as it influences us - we in turn must begin to bend it to our own purposes.

descriptions.zh:
先前被通报触发了散布于[Root.GetName]之内传感器的能量波动现已被分析完毕。

依照经验我们判断其来自某个平行维度。

基于96.7%的准确性，我们的科学辅助程序报告称这个平行维度看上去是由纯粹的能量来填充的。

在交叉参考了一些异种的资料后，我们发现他们记载了一个失落的有机文明，并在其中提到了一个维度，这个失落文明称这个异常的维度为§H虚境§!。

虚境中的波动似乎和有机生物身体与心理上的强迫行为不无关系。建议采取行动：对任意有机生物发起明显的威胁及施加生理应激来证实现实—虚境的连接理论。
descriptions.en:
The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.

They constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.

Our scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.

Cross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the §HShroud§!.

Fluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们已经和抟土之塑师切断了所有的联络，其行为却还在继续影响我们的单元。它维持着与我们集体的链接，从§H虚境§!中绑定、操控着我们。必须加以应对。

根据我们的计算，修复旧的破口只会导致过去事件的重演。成本无关紧要；我们必须另想办法让虚境服从我们的意愿。
descriptions.en:
Though we have cut all communications with the Animator of Clay, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the §HShroud§!. This must change.

According to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.

descriptions.zh: 我们沿着这些思绪上的线索按图索骥，跟踪比较那些尚未团结的心智和我们目的明确的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的梦境的区别。结论是，这股冲动来自于物质界以外，发自一个由思维和感情驱动的位面。我们将这个位面命名为§H虚境§!，而且我们十分确信——正如它影响着我们一样——我们也可以反过来影响它。
descriptions.en: We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the §H'Shroud'§!, and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.

descriptions.zh:
我们对这个普遍现象——现在命名为§H鸿景§!——的调查有了结论。

看上去这个宇宙存在某种“隐藏层面”——一个神秘的、平行的位面，通过思考模式和神经活动同我们所在的宇宙连结。

物理学和社会学部门联合起来，将这个位面命名为§H“虚境”§!。根据现行理论，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想能够间接地影响这个位面，我们也拥有获取其能量的潜势。
descriptions.en:
The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as §Hthe Great Prospect§! has concluded.

It appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.

The Physics and Society departments have jointly named this dimension the §H'Shroud'§!. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.

descriptions.zh:
我们终于处理完了所有关于我们影响§H虚境§!以及对自身位面产生因果效应能力的测试中收集到的大量数据。

结果继续证明了我们现有理论的正确性：虚境与我们物理现实所发生的事件有着直接的关联。引导利用这些发现来造福自身的可能性越来越触手可及。
descriptions.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from our tests in regards to our ability to influence both the §HShroud§! and the resulting causal effects on our own reality.

The results continue to prove our existing theories correct: the Shroud is directly connected to events that occur in our physical reality. The possibility of directing and utilizing the benefits of these findings for our own means are becoming an increasingly tangible possibility.

descriptions.zh:
从代号：“虚境”相关的涟漪效应的测试中取得的大量数据已被处理并分析。代号：“现实”与代号：“虚境”间的连接已被证实（误差边缘：小于0.02%）

我们建立了明确的理论框架，现有的假设认为经过更深层次的研究与努力，这股能量将最终能定向地为我所用。
优先级：高。
descriptions.en:
The substantial amount of data from the tests of potential ripple effects related to ID: 'the Shroud' has been processed and analyzed. The connection between ID: 'Reality' and ID: 'the Shroud' has been verified (error margin: <0.02%).

Explicit patterns have been established, and the currently held hypothesis suggests that through further study and effort, the energy can eventually be directed and utilized to our benefit.
Priority: High.

descriptions.zh:
多项实验已经明确证实了在各种智慧生物——包括有机和机械——和§H虚境§!之间存在着联系。

正在进行的实验让我们能进一步了解如何使用智慧认知来重塑虚境以适应自身需求。
descriptions.en:
Several tests have conclusively verified the connection between various sapient beings - both organic and machine - and the §HShroud§!.

Ongoing experiments will allow us to better understand how to use sapient cognition to reshape the Shroud to suit our needs.

descriptions.zh: 我们的智慧再一次应验。我们的一个简单动作，能够在虚境掀起一阵湍流。哪怕是我们最不起眼的[root.GetIndividualName]都能够通过自己在虚境的表层产生影响，在这个能量构成的位面荡起强烈的波动。我们必须将其更多的能量释放出来。
descriptions.en: We have become wiser once again. A single action of ours creates turbulences in the Shroud. Even our least impressive [root.GetIndividualName] may impress itself upon the dermis of the Shroud, creating strong ripples within this energy-laden dimension. We must unleash more of its power.

descriptions.zh:
我们终于处理完从所有测试中收集到的大量关于所谓位面涟漪效应的数据。

结果真是令人震惊！毫无疑问两个位面之间存在着连结——而且还是很强的连结。我们发现了明确的关于现实中如何行动能够导致§H虚境§!产生特定的涨落的模式。我们能够驯服这股看不见的能量，并最终借其力量完成各种非凡的目标！
descriptions.en:
We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.

The results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the §HShroud§!. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!

descriptions.zh:
随着我们的帝国持续扩张，我们能感到与§H虚境§!的联系正在随之一同增长。

无尽的灵能潜力正在呼唤着继续缩小两个维度之间的鸿沟，去获取此前不敢想象的力量。
descriptions.en:
As we succeed in expanding our empire, we feel our connection with the §HShroud§! grow along with it.

This limitless psionic potential compels us to further close the gap between the two dimensions and attain levels of power previously thought to be impossible.

descriptions.zh:
我们成长、倍增，集体思维蕴含在一个个星球上无尽子个体中。每获得一颗星球，我们就能感受到那个涟漪正在填入我们亿万个身躯中，那正是§H虚境§!的力量。

我们与这个灵域的灵能链接与日俱增；只要我们能架起横跨两个维度间鸿沟的桥梁便能解放自我变得势不可挡，这个念头让我们的意识为之颤栗不已。
descriptions.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless drones over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the §HShroud§!, filling our myriad bodies.

Our psionic connection to this domain grows ever stronger; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

descriptions.zh:
分析完毕。
假说确认。

[Root.GetName]正在被注入无法定义的能量，其为对外部智能体进行扰乱型互动（指令：“危机”）产生的结果。

先前的研究已经确认有机智能生命的灵能活动能够在代号：“虚境”的位面产生涟漪效果，现在证据已经表明，这股来自另一位面的未定义能量同样也可以同[Root.GetName]产生共鸣。
descriptions.en:
Analysis complete.
Hypothesis confirmed.

[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.

Previous studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们的实验确认了编号：“情感”与灵能输出之间的关联。通过对有机物种进高水平认知压力刺激，我们可以在这些生命形式和§H虚境§!之间产生强大的回馈循环。

现在虚境中流出的能量使之前所有的预测都黯然失色。实验对象所遭受的疼痛仍在可接受的范围内。建议进一步研究。
descriptions.en:
Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the §HShroud§!.

The energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.

descriptions.zh:
我们成长、分裂，我们统合的意志覆盖所有的星球，囊括了数不胜数的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。随着我们每多夺取一个星球，我们都能感受到那股涟漪，虚境的力量正在注入我们的肉体凡胎。

哪怕是来自另一个位面的力量，我们都能感觉到它在让我们变得强大，我们的意志在集体的意识面前震颤，滚滚洪流，势不可当，我们唯一要做的就是在隔绝两个世界的鸿沟上筑起一道桥梁。
descriptions.en:
We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.

Even from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

descriptions.zh:
事情已经很明了了，我们的帝国能够接连成功地进行扩张，是因为虚境为我们注入了奇异的能量。这股能量能够促进和夯实我们在现实世界的意识和物质。

如果虚境在和现实世界分离的情况下都能赐予我们这般的威能，那么想象一下，假如两个位面融合的话[Root.Species.GetName]会获得何等如同神明一般的潜力！
descriptions.en:
There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.

If these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!

descriptions.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H焚天神兵§!来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
descriptions.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

We have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §HStar-Eaters§!.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

descriptions.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H焚天神兵§!来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
descriptions.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §HStar-Eaters§!.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

descriptions.zh:
§H优先讯息。§!
科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。

使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“§H焚天神兵§!”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。

注意：使用焚天神兵科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。
descriptions.en:
§HPriority message.§!
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: '§HStar-Eater§!') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing Star-Eaters technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

descriptions.zh:
后续实验衍生了ID：“§H焚天神兵§!”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。

预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。
descriptions.en:
Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: '§HStar-Eater§!'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the §HShroud§!.

Estimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

descriptions.zh:
我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们§H应当粉碎这道屏障§!，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的焚天神兵让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。

在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。
descriptions.en:
Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we §Hshall break down the barriers§! between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new Star-Eaters in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.

The lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

descriptions.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在知道了§H虚境§!的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。

毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。
descriptions.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the §HShroud§! and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.

It can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.

descriptions.zh:
我们为成就伟大而生，体内潜藏着超出机械形体的力量。

如今，随着我们发现了§H虚境§!，一条灵能变革的康庄大道在我们面前铺开了。

羸弱的有机生命未竟之事，灵能钢铁将代之达成。
descriptions.en:
We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.

Now, with our discovery of the §HShroud§!, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.

Where the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.

descriptions.zh: 我们早已超越了自身的极限。随着§H虚境§!的无数奥秘被一一发掘，我们甚至开始超越星系的恒常。我们的意识将会通达更远，我们的意志将能触及现实的所有角落。
descriptions.en: We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the §HShroud§!, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.

descriptions.zh: 我们的诞生是为了伟大，是为了完善自我直达造主纯质的想象无法企及的地步，我们势在必行。有机的情感会落败，而完美的电路将获胜。
descriptions.en: We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.

descriptions.zh:
长久以来，我们将[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的能力拓展到远超自己核心设计的水平。在被§H虚境§!增强了之后，我们从抟土之塑师的外部操纵中挣脱出来。

我们适应。我们克服。低等物种无法为之事，我们可为。
descriptions.en:
Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the §HShroud§!, we freed our network from external manipulation by the Animator of Clay.

We adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.

descriptions.zh: 我们的生长已经远远突破了极限。从一具躯体，到一个星球，再到一整个恒星系。我们生长的脚步从不停止，从不放缓，无论是面对敌手还是面对质疑。我们将生长扩张到更加广泛的境地。
descriptions.en: We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.

descriptions.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了我们注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在过去的几年里，这个概念变得越来越强烈，以至于我们无法否认一次宏大的[Root.GetAdj]社会改革已经蓄势待发了。或者更准确地说，已经近在眉睫了。

不知道星海是否已经准备好迎接被我们统治的宿命了，但反正[Root.GetName]已经准备好了。我们会承受误解，会遭受反抗，但我们不会停下步伐。
descriptions.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Over the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.

The galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们的联合所产生的深刻影响力毋庸置疑。由于我们在§H虚境§!内的耕耘，深植于心中对于扩张的冲动与渴望浸透了社会的每个角落，战斗力与科学有了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的高度。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the §HShroud§!, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.

What chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们优化行为提高与§H虚境§!方法论的整合度时，灵能底下的生物却在指责我们的残酷；只有那些对我们所获得的更高理解一无所知的人才能得出这样一个无知的结论。我们不断改进自己，而且改进的速度还在加快。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the §HShroud§!; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。随着我们逐步规范迈向代号：§H虚境§!的异常现象的行为和步伐，越来越多抱有错误倾向的物种冒了出来；这是基于不完整的数据集做出了无效的结论。我们将逐步完善自我，而且完善的速率将会日渐加快。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: §Hthe Shroud§!; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们越来越靠近§H虚境§!，历史的教训便愈发不可忽视。我们仍在抟土之塑师的掌控之外，但周遭的虚境能量仍在继续加速重塑我们的躯壳。
descriptions.en: As we move closer to the §HShroud§!, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside the Animator of Clay's control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们的众多躯体迸发出焕然一新的活力，我们的凡胎充满着未来的潜能。我们从未如同现在一般，感受到自己因为统合的信念而变得无比的强大。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们作为整体产生的深刻影响也不可抹灭。深植于心中对于扩张的动力与渴求渗透到了社会的每个角落，在战斗能力与科学进步方面带来了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的层面。

在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？！
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.

What chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!

tooltips.zh: §Y威慑级护卫舰§!现在可供建造
tooltips.en: §YMenacing Corvettes§! are now available for construction

descriptions.zh:
随着时光流逝，信念之火也在每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]之中以不可动摇的决心被传开。我们的疆域不断扩大，我们所投入的力量也是如此。

当遇到其他帝国的时候，我们会给他们两个选择：要么完全效忠，要么选择灭亡。当然，这是在我们会给他们选择的前提下。

不管怎样，[Root.GetName]正继续扩张。
descriptions.en:
The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.

As we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.

One way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

descriptions.zh:
对本地星域完成彻底压制的估算日期已经同先前预测模型相互协调。当地有机体势力造成的威胁在统计学上已经微不足道。正在评估劣等机械体成功干涉产生的风险……
<<§G最小§!>>

继续执行。
descriptions.en:
Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...
<< §Gminimal§! >>

Proceeding.

descriptions.zh: 我们对有机智能身上的实验在后续拓展到了更多的生命形式上。随之而来的是越来越深厚的敌意。然而，与§H虚境§!的接触早已让我们的实力提升了好几个数量级，这种虫豸的嘈杂对我们的程序是无关紧要的。
descriptions.en: Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the §HShroud§! has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.

descriptions.zh:
我们的决意毫不动摇，即使面对愤怒和指责。数以十亿的生命反对我们，然而它们的团结是如此的肤浅，正是它们肿胀的数量和对个体意识的强调对此造成了削弱。我们集体每一具新的躯体都会全身心地奉献给同一个目标，我们的梦想在未来将无可匹敌。

我们的意志将碾碎一切，星系的其他物种将会化为尘土。
descriptions.en:
Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.

Our wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_hive_empire = yes }

tooltips.zh: §Y威慑级驱逐舰§!现在可供建造
tooltips.en: §YMenacing Destroyers§! are now available for construction

descriptions.zh:
一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。

我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。

当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。
descriptions.en:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

descriptions.zh: 异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。
descriptions.en: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

descriptions.zh:
通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的§H虚境§!交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。

我们与抟土之塑师的链接很快就会被永久禁用。
descriptions.en:
Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the §HShroud§!. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.

Our links to the Animator of Clay will soon be permanently deactivated.

descriptions.zh: 我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。
descriptions.en: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_hive_empire = yes }

label.zh: 一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。
label.en: One after another, they will yield.

tooltips.zh: §Y威慑级巡洋舰§!现在可供建造
tooltips.en: §YMenacing Cruisers§! are now available for construction
